query: SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = 'agentic-qa-sandbox' AND [System.WorkItemType] = 'Bug' AND [System.State] IN ('Closed', 'Resolved', 'Done') ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC
vocabulary: Paper F event schema (Defects4J + BugsInPy, 1,323 defects); surfaces inferred from bug text, not from fix diffs

records.title: Registration accepts a 3-character password
records.evidence: "server accepts anything non-empty" — POST /api/Users with 3-char password returns 201 Created; expected 400 with 'Password must be at least 8 characters'

records.title: Log in button stays enabled while the form is invalid
records.evidence: "The 'Log in' button is enabled and focusable" when both email and password fields are empty; button should be disabled until both fields are valid

records.title: Removing a product from the basket leaves the row behind
records.evidence: "BasketItem rows are not deleted when the parent is, so the next read picks them up again" — persisted database rows survive removal, totals revert on reload

records.title: Password reset links point at localhost in staging
records.evidence: "The base URL is read from APP_BASE_URL, which was never set for the staging deployment, so it fell back to the development default"

records.title: Search returns no results for some products after the 2.3.0 release
records.evidence: "Searching for certain products returns nothing... Seems to affect newer products more than older ones" — ambiguous; no specific surface named in report; least specific applicable surface used

records.title: Checkout suite fails intermittently — "email already registered"
records.evidence: "The application behaves correctly; the test does not" — checkout spec registers email in beforeEach without cleanup; re-run against same container returns 409
